video_title: Yaxel Lendeborg Is Giving Steph What the Warriors Missed With Kuminga

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Kuminga and James Wiseman failed to meet Golden State's championship expectations
quotes.excerpt: The young players have to adjust. We aren't just passing the guard off to the young players.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Young players can bring life. That honestly was probably the most devastating thing about Kuminga and Wiseman. Those were what they were supposed to be. For whatever reason, whether Wiseman had injuries, the Golden State system was able to win a championship. So it was like, no, we're still in our championship window. The young players have to adjust. We aren't just passing the guard off to the young players. These boys have to adjust because we're still in our championship window.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: I know, but I'm saying, at this point in time, Yaxel and Kuminga are the same age.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Yeah, but I'm saying his maturity level is.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Curry needs more consistent support to sustain his high-level performance
quotes.excerpt: Think about how much he had to do to win. How can he sustain that?
quotes.quote: It's a lot for Steph early on. He's going to have these hero games where he's getting 40. I'll say the same thing about Luka. As these young teams are starting to have to compete, think about how much he had to do to win. Getting 40, getting 52, going and doing these hero games, how can he sustain that? I think Yaxel being older is going to help because he's going to be a little bit more consistent with his approach to the game, with his approach to life. But they're going to need something else. They're a good team because they got Steph, Yaxel is surprising, but once these things start to roll down the hill, they're going to have to add or subtract something to get some more life in there.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Jimmy Butler's return would make the Warriors a legitimate championship threat
quotes.excerpt: If Jimmy healthy, and you have Steph and you have Yaxel, they are a problem.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: But you know what that addition is? Jimmy Butler.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: He's not coming back for another three months.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: But still, it's enough to keep them relevant. Think about where the West is at right now. If Jimmy healthy, and the Porzingis thing, they've had it, they've had it. But if Jimmy healthy, if Jimmy's healthy and you have Steph and you have Yaxel, they are a problem. With the injuries that's going on in the West, they are still a problem.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel Lendeborg's versatility as a third option elevates the Warriors' roster
quotes.excerpt: The more problems you got down your roster, the better you going to be.
quotes.quote: If he can be a legit third, which he is a defender, he does dirty work, he also has shown the athleticism and size to score. So now if he's complementing Steph and Jimmy Butler, and he's the third kind of young player, think Jordan Poole. When Jordan Poole, he was a problem when it was Steph, it was Klay, and those boys were still in it, Jordan Poole was a problem. Then they had Wiggins over there who was balling. So it's like, the more problems you got down your roster, the better you going to be.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel Lendeborg is actively initiating the Warriors' offense rather than waiting
quotes.excerpt: He's initiating the fucking offense and like breaking people down.
quotes.quote: The thing that impresses me the most is that they're not sitting up here, it's not the old Golden State system where it's like, we're going to run all these actions. You still run a lot of actions because you got Steph, but he's not waiting on people to pass him the ball on stand-still threes or his points are coming, he's initiating the fucking offense and like breaking people down. When Steph goes out the game, the ball is in his hands and I'm sitting up here saying, oh this motherfucker is really legit.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Warriors are running a new offensive style designed around Yaxel Lendeborg
quotes.excerpt: They saw what they had, they see the makeup of their team, so they created a style.
quotes.quote: Draymond talked about playing a different, they were playing a new style. He had talked about that they were playing a new style in the preseason and how he was kind of getting acclimated to it. So again, this is by design. I think this was being worked on. They saw what they had, they see the makeup of their team, so they created a style that was a little bit, it's an evolution of what the old Warriors were. But Draymond talked about the ball's not in his hands as much to be the playmaker 100% and then everything is circled around Steph.
